messages.subject: QC threshold parameters
parts:
Hi Xiao,

Yes, normally the default QC parameters work. However I suggest you check the output of your code as a sanity check:


> qcObj=qc(Y,sampname,chr,ref,mapp,gc,cov_thresh=c(20,4000),length_thresh=c(20,2000),mapp_thresh=0.9,gc_thresh=c(20,80))
Excluded 278 exons due to extreme coverage.
Excluded 6 exons due to extreme exonic length.
Excluded 247 exons due to extreme mappability.
Excluded 18 exons due to extreme GC content.
After taking union, excluded 501 out of 12916 exons in QC.



There’s also an output from the latest version of CODEX where a qcmat.txt will be generated with detailed QC procedure information.

Let me know if you’ve any more questions,
Yuchao


On Mar 5, 2015, at 5:36 PM, Xiao Ji <jix...@mail.med.upenn.edu> wrote:

Hi Yuchao,

I'm playing with CODEX now on my WES data in trios and case/control
setting and I have a question:

Are the default parameters/thresholds in your vignettes universally
good for any scenario/experimental settings? Do you recommend any
adjustment to the default parameters?

best,
Xiao
